ActionDescriptions.ToDispatchSupervisoryEvent:
to handle one session event callback payload
callbackJson - canonical SessionEventCallback JSON payload. Returns compact callback summary text for supervisory handling.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetLevel1SessionPlanMarkdownBySourceSe:
to fetch source session plan artifact for level2
sourceSessionKey - the supervised Level1 session key. Returns get-session-artifact-text payload for Plan.md from that source session.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetLevel1SessionScratchMarkdownBySourc:
to fetch source session scratch artifact for level2
sourceSessionKey - the supervised Level1 session key. Returns get-session-artifact-text payload for Scratch.md from that source session.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetLevel1SessionTaskMarkdownBySourceSe:
to fetch source session task artifact for level2
sourceSessionKey - the supervised Level1 session key. taskArtifactFileName - root-level task artifact file name (task-*.md). Returns get-session-artifact-text payload for that task artifact from the source session.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetObservedSessionKey:
to find the session this level2 watcher is supervising
Returns the canonical observed session key stored on the current watcher session user state.
ActionDescriptions.ToListLevel1SessionTaskArtifactNamesBySo:
to list observed session task artifacts
sourceSessionKey - the supervised Level1 session key. Returns JSON array of root-level task artifact file names matching task-*.md from that source session.
ActionDescriptions.ToQueueMessageToObservedSessionAndReturn:
to queue guidance to the currently supervised level1 session
instruction - message text to queue for a future turn in the observed/subscribed source session. This is not live delivery. Inter-session admission is limited to two queued messages and may reject without mutation; use active steering for an active turn or replace an existing queued update. Automatically prepends [label: Level 2] when no supported label is already present.
